packageRules.description: Carry both crates in one PR so a version split arrives as a reviewable update instead of a compile error. See the markup5ever_rcdom pin comment in Cargo.toml for why the versions must match.

Hold markup5ever_rcdom at the 0.38 line htmd 0.5.5 requires. The group rule above does not cover this on its own: renovate places co-occurring updates in one PR, but still opens a PR for whichever crate has an update. PR #374 bumped this crate alone and failed to compile.
